name: Wolf and The Warren
source:
Sam Bane the Wolf is travelling across the country to start her new job in the big city. But, oh no, her car has broken down on a remote forest road just as a storm rolls in over the mountains.

As luck would have it though, she's broken down close to the best kept secret in the woods; a quaint little roadside hotel called ‘The Warren’. Well, there’s no escaping the storm at this rate, Sam’s going to have to stay the night.

She quickly meets the Night Manager of her new lodgings, an adorable Bunny called ‘Kylie’ and the two become fast friends. Turns out, they're the only two patrons of the Hotel on this dark & stormy night....

What will happen as the pair ride out the storm in the safety and comfort of the Warren Hotel? Come and find out!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3584070/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
狼小姐萨姆·贝恩正驱车横跨全国，准备前往大城市开始新工作。可糟糕的是，就在暴风雨翻越群山席卷而来之际，她的车却抛锚在了偏僻的林间公路上。

不过不幸中的万幸是，抛锚地点不远处就藏着这片森林里最隐秘的宝地——一家古雅别致的路边小旅馆“兔巢”。眼看暴风雨避无可避，萨姆只能在这里借宿一晚了。

她很快见到了下榻之处的夜间经理——一只名叫“凯莉”的可爱兔子，两人一见如故。原来在这个漆黑的风雨之夜，整间旅馆里就只有她们两位住客……

在安全舒适的兔巢旅店里共度暴风雨的两人之间会发生怎样的故事？快来一探究竟吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3584070/]Steam[/url]]
